edges.reason: msg.sender supplies both spender and src to transfer.
dst parameter flows into transfer.
amount parameter flows into transfer.
transfer delegates to transferTokens.
transferFrom delegates to transferTokens.
src parameter flows into transferFrom.
transferTokens updates transferAllowances after spending.
transferTokens writes accountTokens for src and dst.
external bController.transferVerify hook is invoked from transferTokens.
transfer is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
transferFrom is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
nonReentrant toggles the _notEntered guard variable.
spender parameter flows into approve.
amount parameter flows into approve.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner in approve.
mintInternal calls mintFresh after accruing interest.
msg.sender is passed as the minter into mintInternal.
mintAmount parameter flows into mintInternal.
mintFresh calls doTransferIn before writing totalSupply/accountTokens.
doTransferIn performs an external ERC20 transferFrom on the underlying token.
mintFresh invokes the external bController.mintVerify hook.
mintFresh writes the new totalSupply.
mintFresh writes the minter accountTokens balance.
redeemInternal calls redeemFresh after accruing interest.
redeemFresh calls doTransferOut before writing totalSupply/accountTokens.
doTransferOut sends underlying assets out to the redeemer.
redeemFresh invokes the external bController.redeemVerify hook.
borrowInternal calls borrowFresh after accruing interest.
borrowFresh calls doTransferOut before writing borrow state.
borrowFresh invokes the external bController.borrowVerify hook.
borrowFresh writes the new totalBorrows value.
borrowFresh writes the borrower accountBorrows snapshot.
repayBorrowInternal calls repayBorrowFresh.
repayBorrowFresh calls doTransferIn before updating borrow balances.
repayBorrowFresh writes the borrower accountBorrows snapshot.
repayBorrowFresh writes the reduced totalBorrows.
liquidateBorrowInternal calls liquidateBorrowFresh.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls repayBorrowFresh for the liquidator.
liquidateBorrowFresh makes an external seize call to the collateral bToken.
liquidateBorrowFresh invokes the external bController.liquidateBorrowVerify hook.
seize forwards to seizeInternal.
msg.sender, not a parameter, is used as the seizer token for authorization.
seizeInternal invokes the external bController.seizeVerify hook.
seizeInternal writes borrower and liquidator accountTokens balances.
borrowAmount parameter flows into borrowFresh.
repayAmount parameter flows into repayBorrowFresh.
borrower parameter flows into liquidateBorrowFresh.
liquidator parameter flows into seizeInternal.
redeemTokens parameter flows into redeemFresh.
redeemAmount parameter flows into redeemFresh.
tokens parameter flows into transferTokens.
accrueInterest writes the new accrualBlockNumber checkpoint.
accrueInterest writes the new borrowIndex.
accrueInterest writes the new totalBorrows.
accrueInterest writes the new totalReserves.
currentBlockNumber local feeds the interest accrual computation.
initialize requires msg.sender to equal admin before proceeding.
initialize sets the initial accrualBlockNumber.
initialize sets the initial borrowIndex.
_setPendingAdmin checks msg.sender against admin.
_setPendingAdmin writes pendingAdmin.
_acceptAdmin checks msg.sender against pendingAdmin.
_acceptAdmin promotes pendingAdmin into the admin variable.
_setBController checks msg.sender against admin.
_setBController replaces the bController state variable.
_reduceReserves calls _reduceReservesFresh after accrual.
_reduceReservesFresh performs a raw subtraction of reserves.
the raw subtraction result is stored into totalReserves.
_reduceReservesFresh transfers reserves out to admin after the state update.
totalReservesNew local carries the new reserves value.
_setPendingImplementation checks msg.sender against admin.
_setPendingImplementation writes pendingImplementation.
newPendingImplementation parameter flows into _setPendingImplementation.
_acceptImplementation checks msg.sender against pendingImplementation.
_acceptImplementation promotes pendingImplementation into implementation.
BirdCore _setPendingAdmin checks msg.sender against admin.
BirdCore _setPendingAdmin writes pendingAdmin.
BirdCore _acceptAdmin checks msg.sender against pendingAdmin.
BirdCore _acceptAdmin promotes pendingAdmin into admin.
the fallback delegatecalls the mutable implementation with attacker-controlled msg.data.
delegatecall forwards the caller's msg.sender context into arbitrary implementation code.
_addReservesInternal calls _addReservesFresh after accrual.
_addReservesFresh calls doTransferIn before updating totalReserves.
_addReservesFresh performs a raw addition into reserves.
the unchecked sum is written into totalReserves.
MintLocalVars holds intermediate mint computation results.
allowed return value from the bController hook steers the transfer path.

redeemInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
borrowInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
repayBorrowInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
liquidateBorrowInternal is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
seize is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.
_reduceReserves is protected by the nonReentrant modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: The allowed local is nothing more than the return value of the external bController policy hook.
The totalReservesNew local is the direct result of the unchecked reserve arithmetic before being stored.
